mcq.question: How many times does the transform run in `iota(1) | transform(f) | take(3)` when all three results are read?

options.D: It depends on the size of the int type

mcq.explanation: Views are lazy. Only the elements actually read are computed, so an infinite iota is fine.

mcq.question: What does the projection in `std::ranges::sort(orders, std::ranges::greater{}, &Order::cents)` do?

options.A: It sorts only the `cents` values and drops the orders
options.C: It converts orders to cents permanently
options.D: It compares orders by their `cents` member, largest first

mcq.explanation: The projection is applied before each comparison. The whole orders are still what gets sorted.
